column2: a modern polymer-frame striker-fired 9mm service pistol, generic original design (no brand, no logo, no text): squared slide with angled rear serrations, ejection port, low 3-dot sights, accessory rail under the dust cover, squared trigger guard, slightly raked textured grip, flush magazine with a small base plate, visible slide stop lever and magazine release button. Slide dark gunmetal #2E3034, frame near-black #1C1D1F

a modern compact polymer-frame pistol with a long cylindrical suppressor screwed on a threaded barrel that sticks out past the slide, generic original design (no brand, no logo, no text): squared slide with front and rear serrations, raised suppressor-height sights, external slide stop and magazine release, extended magazine base plate. Slide #2E3034, frame dark olive #6B7A3A, suppressor matte near-black #1A1B1C with three thin grooves

a modern double-action six-shot revolver with a 4-inch barrel and full-length underlug, generic original design (no brand, no logo, no text): swing-out cylinder with six flutes, ejector rod under the barrel, exposed hammer with a spur, smooth trigger in a round trigger guard, cylinder release latch, ramp front sight, rubber finger-groove grip. Steel #6E7076, grip dark brown #5C3A23

a compact open-bolt 9mm machine pistol (mini submachine gun), generic original design (no brand, no logo, no text): boxy stamped steel receiver with a ribbed top cover and a cocking knob on top, short barrel with a front sight hood, long straight magazine inserted through the pistol grip, grip safety, folding wire stock folded under and back in a side view showing it extended behind, small fire selector. Near-black #1C1D1F and gunmetal #2E3034

a modern 5.56 gas-operated assault carbine, generic original design (no brand, no logo, no text): flat-top upper receiver with a short red-dot optic, free-floating slotted M-LOK handguard, forward assist and dust cover over the ejection port, T-shaped charging handle at the rear of the upper, curved 30-round polymer magazine, ambidextrous safety selector, pistol grip, collapsible stock with a rubber butt pad, birdcage flash hider. Receiver and handguard warm tan #968060, magazine and small parts near-black #1C1D1F

a modern semi-automatic designated marksman rifle, generic original design (no brand, no logo, no text): long free-floated handguard, fixed adjustable precision stock with a cheek riser, 20-round straight box magazine, side charging handle on the left of the receiver, ejection port with a dust cover, 4x mid-length scope on two rings, two-port muzzle brake. Olive drab #6B7A3A furniture, near-black #1C1D1F metal

a modern bolt-action precision sniper rifle on an aluminium chassis, generic original design (no brand, no logo, no text): long heavy fluted barrel with a large muzzle brake, bolt with a round knob handle sticking out the right side, detachable box magazine, folding bipod under the fore-end shown folded forward, long scope with flip-up lens caps on both ends and turrets, adjustable skeleton stock with cheek piece and butt pad. Chassis olive #8A9C4A, metal near-black #1C1D1F

a modern tactical 12-gauge pump-action shotgun, generic original design (no brand, no logo, no text): receiver with a loading port underneath and a side ejection port, tube magazine under the barrel with a ribbed polymer fore-end pump around it, bead front sight, ghost-ring rear sight, synthetic pistol-grip stock with a rubber recoil pad, side saddle holding four shells (olive green hulls #6B7A3A with steel heads). Near-black #1C1D1F and gunmetal #2E3034

a matched pair of modern compact polymer pistols shown as one pistol in side view, generic original design (no brand, no logo, no text): short squared slide with forward and rear serrations, extended ported compensator block at the muzzle, flared magazine well, extended slide stop and magazine release, skeletonised trigger. Slide cream-grey #C8C4BA, frame near-black #1C1D1F
